gloss: to taper to a point; to become sharp; to become tense

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {尖|とが}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to taper to a point; to become sharp
definitions.explanation: To narrow or sharpen to a pointed end.

definitions.gloss: to become tense; to be on edge
definitions.explanation: To become irritable or nervous, often shown in facial expression.

notes:
{尖|とが}る is intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧). The transitive pair is ⟦{尖|とが}らせる→尖らせる：28907_togaraseru⟧ (to sharpen, to make pointed).

ASPECT (ている):
{尖|とが}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a resulting state of being pointed or sharp.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{尖|とが}る (the tip becomes sharp)
- ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{尖|とが}る (nerves become frayed)
- ⟦{口|くち}→口：00560_kuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{尖|とが}らせる (to pout - uses transitive form)
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{尖|とが}る: What becomes pointed

The figurative sense of being "on edge" or tense is common in everyday conversation.
